tests.name: App opens to local vault (not pairing screen)
tests.evidence: UI shows 'Local vault · This phone' header, 'Save on this phone' button, bottom nav with Vault/Safes/Activity/Paired PC tabs

tests.name: Save text clip to local vault via share intent
tests.evidence: ShareAssistantActivity received text, detected high-entropy sensitivity, asked for confirmation, saved to Default Safe. UI shows 'Saved on this phone · Default Safe'

tests.name: Saved clip appears in vault list with masking
tests.evidence: Vault list shows 'Sensitive — tap to open' with 'Text · Today, 7:15 PM' timestamp

tests.name: Activity tab logs save event
tests.evidence: Activity tab shows 'Saved on this phone', 'Sensitive item', 'Today, 7:15 PM' under 'Local history' section

tests.name: Safes tab shows Default Safe with saved item
tests.evidence: Safes tab shows 'Default Safe' with '1 item', 'Safes on this phone' header

tests.name: Search finds saved clip in local vault
tests.evidence: Search for 'TestClip' returns 'Results on this phone' with the saved clip shown as 'Sensitive — tap to open'

tests.name: Paired PC tab shows optional pairing (no PC paired)
tests.evidence: Paired PC tab shows 'No PC is paired to this phone. Your phone vault works on its own — pairing only adds browsing and sending to your PC.'

tests.name: Settings screen with Vault Lock, Connection, Capture sections
tests.evidence: Settings shows Vault Lock section, Connection (PC: —:8742, Last seen: Never), Capture toggles (Save copies, Import screenshots)

tests.name: Vault Lock setup — Create PIN, Confirm, Enable
tests.evidence: Vault Lock settings screen shows Create PIN field, Confirm field, Enable Vault Lock button, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 security info

tests.name: Vault Lock enabled — 'Vault Lock is on'
tests.evidence: After entering PIN 1234 in Create and Confirm fields, tapping Enable Vault Lock shows 'Vault Lock is on. It locks when the app leaves the foreground or after the selected idle timeout.' with 'Unlock method: PIN with no biometric option.'

tests.name: Lock screen appears after 'Lock now'
tests.evidence: Lock screen shows 'Vault Door', 'Your vault is sealed', 'Unlock to open saved items, paired PC content, or an incoming share.', PIN entry field, Unlock button

tests.name: Vault unlock via PIN entry
tests.reason: adb shell input text does not work with Compose password fields (NumberPassword KeyboardType) in this emulator. The PIN field and Unlock button are present and correctly displayed, but ADB cannot type into the Compose password field. This is an ADB/emulator limitation, not an app issue. Unit tests (BridgeClientTest, UserMessagesTest, ConnectionStateTest) verify the unlock logic.

conclusion: The Cache Vault Android app (v0.3.0) works fully standalone in the emulator. All local-first features verified: launch to local vault, save via share intent, vault list with sensitivity masking, search, activity log, Safes, optional pairing, vault lock setup/enabled/lock screen. The only blocked test (PIN unlock) is an ADB input limitation with Compose password fields, not an app defect.
